slides.en: Rice, toppings, and a pot of dashi
slides.body: Fuurinkazan, Naha. Yu had dashi chazuke set No.3, grilled mentaiko and takana (¥1,100): rice, the toppings, pickles, and a pot of dashi to pour over. He added salmon and shiso-takana. Yu: delicious.

Six dashi chazuke sets, ¥1,100–1,750. Grilled fish from ¥650 (mackerel); salted salmon ¥900 for two pieces, ¥450 for one. Add rice, miso soup and mozuku for +¥300 (A set), or every small dish too for +¥600 (B set). Toppings from ¥150. (Menu at the shop, Nov 2026)

slides.body: Fuurinkazan, about 260 m from Kenchomae Station (Yui Rail). 7:00–14:30 (LO 14:00), listed as open every day, including Sundays and holidays. Counter seats. (AutoReserve listing, Nov 18)
